page.title: Tracking property enquiries/leads
page.description: Discover how the PropertyList infrastructure powers effortless lead generation. Learn how to manage MLS referrals, capture direct buyers through personalised URL window cards, and leverage the public portal to secure highly qualified leads directly into your Smart CRM.
page.body:
Tracking Property Enquiries: Mastering Lead Generation


Effortless lead generation is at the core of the PropertyList ecosystem. We provide the strategic infrastructure to ensure your properties reach the exact right audience, maximising your chances of securing highly qualified leads.
By centralising your deal flow, you can track and convert opportunities from three distinct channels:

MLS LEADS

Upload your exclusive mandates to our secure MLS portal and instantly tap into a vast, collaborative network of verified agencies and agents across Andalucía - with further expansion coming soon. This broadens your market reach significantly, attracting a much larger pool of qualified clients for your active listings.
  • How to manage: Click the “MLS LEADS” tab on your dashboard. From this command centre, you can manage all your incoming MLS co-broking leads and strategically assign specific enquiries directly to your staff members for rapid follow-up.

DIRECT PORTAL LEADS

By listing your properties for free on the PropertyList network, they will soon be advertised globally on our public property portal, gaining major exposure to direct buyers and tenants. You can secure these highly qualified public leads using your credits - a highly cost-effective, pay-as-you-go method to maximise your chances of a successful sale without expensive subscriptions.

MICROSITE LEADS (website made just for you)

The infrastructure allows you to share your properties instantly using unique, personalised url for your MicroSite. Each digital listing features a streamlined contact form built directly into the bottom of the page, making it completely frictionless for potential direct buyers or tenants to reach out and request a viewing.
  • How to manage: Click the “DIRECT LEADS” tab on your dashboard. Here, you can manage all your Landing Page URL leads and seamlessly assign these direct client enquiries to your team.

Intelligent Automation & Tracking

The moment a buyer submits an enquiry, the infrastructure takes over. Every new lead automatically populates into your Smart CRM as a new contact and triggers an instant notification.

If the lead is already in your database, the system smartly updates their existing history timeline with the new message and property interest. This completely automated, streamlined process saves your agency valuable time and ensures you never miss a potential deal.
